description.zh_CN: 工匠与生产人口在此聚集，将区域的生产条件转化为熟练劳动。

institutions.notes: 机构名非锁死名称，不阻塞冻结。

description.zh_CN: 不同工种与技术职业形成稳定分工，共同培养城市的工程人才。

institutions.notes: 机构名非锁死名称，不阻塞冻结。

description.zh_CN: 工程规范、资源统筹与施工组织，使生产经验能够重复，施工力量能够部署。

institutions.notes: 机构名非锁死名称，不阻塞冻结。

description.zh_CN: 成熟的工程体系组织大型建设，并将实践经验与历史积累转化为更深厚的工程能力。

institutions.notes: 名称可单独修改，不改变机械合同。土木工程对某些未来奇观语义较窄，不阻塞冻结。

tooltip.zh_CN: 每名正在工作的工业专家额外提供2点基础大工程师点数，并受到其它伟人点数百分比加成。本城工业区及其每一级建筑各提供1点住房。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Retain SHARED-001 Industry housing and SHARED-002 Engineer base GPP; one ability package.

tooltip.zh_CN: 本城永久掌握区域与建筑建设经验。启用三级工业能力后，本城及通过工业网络取得标准的城市，对合法模板目标获得基础10%建造加速，合法金币／信仰购买基础折扣为0%。四级来源城每完成一次工程传统研习，输出的两项效率各增加2个百分点。不同模板取并集；每一模板仅从实际掌握它的有效工业来源中分别取最高建造效率与最高合法购买折扣，不相加。标准不会因建筑缺失或掠夺遗忘。数值为v0.1首测值。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Use retained template_knowledge/standardization_scope and common network topology. For a valid Industry ACTIVE>=3 source: base construction10 percentage points and existing legal Gold/Faith purchase discount0. At current ACTIVE IV, use all retained city study L: construction=10+2*L%, discount=2*L%; below IV source outputs only base. For each template T, only current valid Industry sources actually holding T supply its efficiencies; construction and legal purchase discount independently MAX within those holders, never across nonholders. Different templates UNION. Practice does not strengthen Standardization. An eligible III receiver may receive stronger T efficiency from another valid IV source that actually holds T.
input_facts: valid connected Industry sources ACTIVE>=3 that actually hold the specific target template
each source current ACTIVE and retained city Tradition study L
abilities.notes_compatibility: Template ledger and activation directory retain IND-REVIEW-01/02. IND-REVIEW-03 global independent maximum and conditional-Faith fallback are superseded by D0045. Gold/Faith price fields alone do not establish legal purchase; no new purchase permission.

tooltip.zh_CN: 启用三级工业能力可组建I至III档施工队；四级额外开放IV、V档，不要求工程传统门槛。三级组建成本为锁定基础施工力的150%；四级按工程实践降低组织损耗。每来源当前Owner最多2支存活本城出身队伍，各档占1槽；消费或合法移除释放，四级不加容量。已完成队伍保留原Owner与固定施工力，不因来源资格或易主失去使用能力。数值为v0.1首测值。

abilities.mechanical_contract: ACTIVE III permits Team tiers I–III; ACTIVE IV additionally permits IV–V, no E/Tradition threshold. Formation cost=Base Transfer Production*current qualified Practice multiplier; III always150%, IV uses N thresholds1/3/6 for140/130/120% (N0=150%). Existing completed Teams remain usable after source downgrade. Exact capacity2, original-owner unit survival and current-owner training-source slot accounting retained. Shared_D0045 professional-unit non-capture contract applies: no enemy capture or Owner conversion; protective retreat/safe return for hostile capture/destruction interactions. Existing source-city transfer/capacity rules remain.
input_facts: city genuine Wonder count N at qualified IV only
abilities.notes_compatibility: Five tiers are capacity tiers, not specialization levels. Megaproject is future extension only.

tooltip.zh_CN: 本城工业ACTIVE四级自行生产所属时代早于本文明当前时代的奇观时，落后1时代获得10%奇观建造生产力，落后2时代20%，落后3时代及以上30%封顶。当前时代奇观无此加成。不放大施工队注入；这些百分比为v0.1首测值。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Current Industry ACTIVE IV city own ordinary Wonder production only. Gap=current civilization era minus Wonder own era, never world/start/completion era. Gap1=>+10%, gap2=>+20%, gap>=3=>+30% cap; current-era Wonder gets none. No Construction Team injection amplification. Numeric curve is initial v0.1 balance, engine era mapping/precision/ordinary modifier stacking remain technical investigation.
input_facts: ordinary own Wonder Production, excluding Team injection
output_effects: own ordinary older-era Wonder Production bonus
abilities.notes_compatibility: Do not invent a generic integer-era formula or modifier stacking fallback. Required final integer Production uses floor under contracts.precision; actual native carrier remains technical investigation.

tooltip.zh_CN: 本城历史真实完成的奇观积累施工组织经验。当前工业ACTIVE四级时，奇观数N=0、1–2、3–5、6+对应施工队组建成本倍率150%、140%、130%、120%。三级不利用实践，一律150%。完成时Owner、身份、ACTIVE或总督不影响城市历史资格。只改变组建投入，不改变队伍锁定施工力，也不强化标准化。数值为v0.1首测值。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Engineering Practice remains a Lv4 ACTIVE IV effect by explicit user clarification. N=all genuine Wonder completions in this persistent city, regardless of completion Owner/Identity/ACTIVE/Governor. At current Industry IV: cumulative thresholds1/3/6 yield multipliers140/130/120%, N0 gives150%; Industry III always150%. Formation cost=locked base transfer capacity*multiplier; no effect on Team own capacity/injection or Standardization. City historical N follows city and survives Identity exit; qualified use pauses/resumes, reliable history/current-provable facts protection retained.
input_facts: city-scoped genuine Wonder completion history N
current supported-owner Industry Identity and ACTIVE IV
output_effects: lower Construction Team formation Production cost
abilities.notes_compatibility: City experience, not civilization completion credit. No Practice Standardization increment/cap or direct Wonder-to-Wonder bonus loop.

tooltip.zh_CN: 全国工程传统E是本文明亲自完成奇观所覆盖的不同奇观时代数量，同一时代只计一次，征服不转移文明信用。工业ACTIVE四级且本城已完成研习L<E时，可用一个完整生产回合完成一次新研习，L增加1。未完整完成则失败、不增加L，重新开始时重做当前轮完整1T，已完成历史L保留。四级输出标准化建造10%+2%×L、合法Gold／Faith折扣2%×L；三级保留L但只输出10%/0%，低于三级不输出。L随城保留、退出身份或失去四级不清零；恢复四级直接恢复全部成果。易主后E<L也不回退已学L。名称与首测数值成熟度分别保留。

abilities.mechanical_contract: E=distinct Wonder own eras completed by this civilization from game start, no completion Identity/ACTIVE requirement; B civilization history never transfers with city. At supported Industry ACTIVE IV, if current L<E, complete a full1 Production Turn study of unabsorbed Tradition => L+1; no ordinary Production cost shortening. L is named A city historical ledger; no5-layer/artificial cap or era whitelist. Its qualified IV Standardization output adds2 percentage points to both efficiencies per L. III outputs10%/0% while retaining L, below III no source output; leaving Industry retains but pauses study/effect, IV resumes all retained L. Owner transfer keeps L without owner partition, including L>E for new Owner; E only limits future additions, no min(L,E) effective clamp. E no longer unlocks Team IV/V. Study uses the same full1T transaction semantics as Era Dialogue: an unfinished Production Turn fails without L increment; restart must redo the entire current1T study, while completed historical L survives. Per-template efficiency is limited to actual valid holder sources; existing legal Gold/Faith channels share the discount.
output_effects: source Standardization construction and legal Gold/Faith purchase efficiencies
abilities.notes_compatibility: N is city Wonder count, E is civilization era coverage, L is city learned Tradition count; three records have different ownership/roles. No per-owner L copy, no restoration from transient carrier, no tier unlock or universal legacy rule.

tooltip.zh_CN: 每名正在工作的工业专家额外获得3点食物，以及相当于本城工业区基础相邻生产力的生产力。该生产力加成当前系数为1，不计政策等相邻倍率；各专业等级均保持同一公式。

base_effects.mechanical_contract: Per working Industry specialist: additional Food=3; additional Production=K*A, A=city Industrial Zone BASE Production adjacency. K is explicit balance parameter, current1, unchanged across Lv1–4. Native specialist yields remain separate.
base_effects.notes_compatibility: No named ability; remove old Lv3 Food upgrade and base-adjacency Gold. Never substitute Research 3F3P.

standard_purchase_discount.scope: existing legal Gold or Faith purchase base; no purchase permission expansion

macro_formula_curve_cap.scope: own production of older-era Wonder at Industry IV; never Team injection

team_project_cost_reference.notes: This is base150% cost, all Industry III or IV with N0. IV qualified140/130/120% costs follow contracts.teams.formation_cost matrix. Original280/460/820/1100/1500 reference superseded; game-speed scaling retained, final integer cost uses floor, actual native carrier still requires technical validation.

team_tier_names.notes: Execution organizations, not era/size labels; tier5 not administrative authority.

tradition_study_turns.notes: No ordinary Production cost shortening; formal project name and engine mechanism not chosen.

practice_wonder_thresholds.scope: ACTIVE IV only; III always base150%

practice_team_cost_multipliers.scope: current Industry IV only; current III uses150%

template_knowledge.learned: Per Industry city permanent ledger, not permanent empire-wide acquisition by recipients. Any legal acquisition/completion of eligible ordinary buildings recorded; initial catch-up at first Industry Identity; completed eligible District templates added. Record before ACTIVE3; no forgetting on demolition/pillage/temporary loss. Preserve old event-incremental/no continuous full-city-scan direction. Ledger is A city historical legacy, follows the persistent city and is not original-owner property.
template_knowledge.available: Local city-owned learned knowledge remains through ACTIVE decline, Industry Identity exit and Owner change. Unsupported owners keep it dormant; any enabled owner may use it after meeting current Industry qualifications.
template_knowledge.propagated: Only currently valid ACTIVE>=3 Industry sources contribute through unchanged common topology; source loss/disconnection withdraws contribution, not learned ledger.
template_knowledge.currently_usable: Local use requires current Industry ACTIVE>=3, or current valid network reception under its own contract; history alone grants no effect. Source city ledger is A city historical legacy, not completing-civilization credit.
template_knowledge.normalization: Unique replacements normalize to base district/building tier or explicitly retained matching group; no duplicate unique standards.

reentry_reconciliation.meaning: City construction experience that can be reliably confirmed, not personal construction by the current player.
reentry_reconciliation.trigger: Lawful first Industry Identity, or entry/re-entry into supported-owner control with restored Industry Identity; not restricted to original-owner recapture.
reentry_reconciliation.result: Reliable saved template history UNION currently existing eligible buildings. Eligible buildings constructed under an AI/unsupported owner count when still present at reconciliation.
reentry_reconciliation.initialize: Only when reliably established that no Industry template ledger has previously initialized; existing eligible buildings form the initial ledger.
reentry_reconciliation.restore: Preserve reliable saved templates, including an initialized empty ledger; do not delete knowledge when a building is currently absent, pillaged or removed.
reentry_reconciliation.reconcile: Add only currently reliably confirmed eligible buildings not yet recorded. Repeated sync is idempotent; no reverse deletion.
reentry_reconciliation.unavailable_history: If past template history should exist but is missing, corrupt or unreadable, keep protection. Do not disguise current-building scan as first initialization or complete historical restoration.
reentry_reconciliation.unobserved_foreign_history: Do not reconstruct buildings created and removed outside supported ownership before reentry and never reliably recorded. No new AI listener or global construction ledger.
reentry_reconciliation.unchanged: Catalog, Standardization efficiencies and current AI/player scope unchanged. City Wonder practice and civilization tradition are separate D0040 assets; unit/source bindings are not resolved here.

standardization_scope.priority: Retained text defines directory/groups/eligibility, NOT old10/20/30/40 rates or low-level rewards. Both efficiency paths use the same target directory. Production targets require legal construction eligibility; purchase effects apply to each currently existing legal Gold or Faith channel. No new purchasing permission and no eligibility inferred from price fields.
standardization_scope.districts: Districts corresponding to retained enabled district directory gain templates on completion and are construction targets; unique replacements normalize. City Center group buildings remain buildings, not a new City Center district template or construction permission. Wonders excluded from ordinary standardization.
standardization_scope.faith: D0045 formal equal-channel rule, not a technical fallback: apply the source discount to each existing legal Gold or Faith price of the eligible template target. Do not add purchase rights or bypass technology, civic, exclusivity, unique/religious qualification. A price field alone is not a legal channel.
standardization_scope.development_investment: If both apply to same legal ordinary building, Standardization Production percent and Commerce Development Investment+50% add: e.g20%+50%=70%, not multiply. Existing Commerce rule retained, not a new Commerce revision.
standardization_scope.adopted_directory_and_matching_groups:
**IND-NET-005 — v0.1目录与匹配组 / D0015保留目录、D0045购买资格更新** 模板记录范围与当前折扣启用范围独立维护。v0.1开启学院、剧院广场、工业区、商业中心、军营、港口、圣地、航空港、水渠、堤坝、社区、娱乐中心、水上乐园、保护区、外交区的建筑，包含特色建筑；只有目标建筑在当前游戏状态下本来就有合法Gold或Faith购买渠道时，才可在满足有效工业网络与模板条件后对对应合法价格使用购买折扣。仍按相同区域+HD Tier匹配，除下述明确市中心分组。记录模板或开启折扣都不会新增Gold/Faith购买资格、解锁特色/宗教建筑、改变科技/市政/互斥条件。不能合法购买的建筑仍可记录，但不因此可购买；不能只凭Gold/Faith价格字段认定合法购买。Faith折扣是正式渠道规则，不再是Gold隔离困难时的技术fallback。

市中心不直接按整个HD Tier0共享。v0.1只开放以下三个模板匹配组：

| 组 | 具体建筑 | 共享规则 |
|---|---|---|
| 市中心基础组 | 纪念碑 BUILDING_MONUMENT、粮仓 BUILDING_GRANARY、磨坊 BUILDING_WATER_MILL、测量仪 BUILDING_NILOMETER_HD、法表 BUILDING_HD_TABLES_OF_LAW | 五者视为同一标准化Tier，相互匹配 |
| 会展中心独立组 | BUILDING_EXHIBITION | 仅自身匹配 |
| 警署独立组 | BUILDING_HD_POLICE_STATION | 仅自身匹配 |

这些是本项目标准化分组，不改写HD原始Tier表。市政广场与上述七栋以外的市中心建筑，当前仅记录而不开放标准化折扣；明确列名的市中心组不自动扩充未列出的特色替代建筑。以后可以由用户批准增加开放范围或组成员，不删除既有模板、不自动将未来范围提前启用。

contracts.network: Connectivity only; retain common NET topology. No independent base Industrial Network reward. Templates UNION across current valid ACTIVE>=3 sources; each template construction/purchase efficiency MAX only over its actual valid holder sources, per standardization_efficiency_by_template. No fabricated low-level payload.

historical_credit.collection: From game start, actual Wonder completion in a city creates its city engineering history regardless of completion Owner, Industry Identity, ACTIVE or Governor. Separately, actual completing civilization receives civilization history credit.
historical_credit.practice: A city historical legacy: all Wonders genuinely completed in this persistent city, regardless of Owner at completion. Any enabled owner meeting current Industry Identity/ACTIVE4 can use it; no completion-owner filter.
historical_credit.tradition: B civilization historical legacy: distinct Wonder own eras from that civilization actual completions. City loss does not erase or transfer credit; conquest never grants prior completing civilization credit to the acquirer.
historical_credit.era: Wonder own era; not player era at completion, world era, or construction start era.
historical_credit.implementation_boundary: For city practice only, reliable saved history may be unioned with currently provable local Wonder completion facts; never invent unverifiable completion history, and never reconstruct civilization completing-owner credit from current possession. Technical recovery/persistence implementation remains separate.
historical_credit.study: Completed L is A city historical legacy, separate from B national E. Preserve L across ACTIVE/Identity/Owner; IV re-enables full L including L>E after transfer. E only gates future study L<E. Unsupported owners keep history dormant; no AI gameplay or global historical tracking authorization.

teams.targets: Only Wonders now; Megaproject future extension not currently eligible. No ordinary District/Building target.
teams.production_gate: Current Industry ACTIVE III tiers I–III; ACTIVE IV additionally IV–V. No E>=4/5 or other Tradition threshold. Existing completed Teams remain usable after source qualification decline.
teams.mechanics_retained: City-project formation with cost under current qualified Practice;1 labor, consume on confirmed legal Wonder construction at required target tile; preview/confirm, reject invalid without consumption, surplus wasted not transferred. No current UX implementation.
teams.speed: Retain prior game-speed scaling direction. Locked Team base capacity=floor(reference capacity*speed CostMultiplier/100); display/settlement use that same integer. Required final Production/Gold/Cost values use floor under contracts.precision, avoiding unnecessary intermediate floors. Standard-speed formation matrix remains initial test values; native other-speed cost carrier requires technical validation. Macro never changes locked capacity or injection.
teams.macro_application: NONE. Team injection=min(locked base capacity,target Wonder remaining Production). No Macro, Wonder Production policy, target city Wonder modifier, Amenities multiplier or other ordinary Production percent/unapproved construction multiplier. Surplus is wasted, no next queue or storage. Source qualification decline does not invalidate completed Team use.
teams.names: Five names TBD; keep execution-organization identity.

formation_cost.formula: floor(Base Transfer Production * Practice Multiplier) at final integer cost settlement; retained game-speed scaling applies, no unnecessary intermediate floor
formation_cost.qualification: III always150%; IV uses genuine city N:0=>150%,1–2=>140%,3–5=>130%,6+=>120%. Practice changes cost only, never locked Team capacity.

team_inventory_capacity.scope: per eligible Industry training source city, counting its CURRENT Owner surviving Teams trained there
team_inventory_capacity.rule: Each completed Team costs1 slot; cap2 across all tiers, no IV extra. Count only surviving Teams owned by current source-city Owner with that original training source. Consumption/legal removal frees slot; retreat while alive does not. No additional completed Team at full capacity.
team_inventory_capacity.binding: Permanent training-source provenance/capacity reference. Completed Team remains original Owner asset and usable despite source Governor/ACTIVE/Industry Identity/Owner changes. New training still requires current Engineering Mobilization qualification.
team_inventory_capacity.respecialization: Existing Teams survive leaving Industry. Source cannot replenish while not qualified as Industry; later consumption does not grant generic unit capacity to new specialization.
remaining_open: Original unit Owner disappearance not defined by source-transfer or non-capture rule
team_inventory_capacity.intended_play: Production banking and advance deployment to time Wonder unlocks are intended; filling old-era Wonders for engineering tradition is intended emergent gameplay.
team_inventory_capacity.owner_change: Source transfer does not delete/transfer old Teams; they do not occupy new Owner capacity. On original Owner recapture, its surviving Teams originally trained there count again: two survivors means2/2, no new training.

tradition_study.national_E: Distinct Wonder own eras actually completed by this civilization from game start. Same-era Wonders count once, completion Identity/ACTIVE not required, late old-era completion valid; city transfer never transfers civilization credit.
tradition_study.city_L: Number of successful full Production Turn studies completed in this persistent city; named A city history, not civilization/Owner partition.
tradition_study.start_qualification: Current supported Industry Identity, ACTIVE IV, L<E for a new unabsorbed study. No five-layer cap, artificial cap or era whitelist.
tradition_study.completion: One full Production Turn, not shortened by ordinary Production cost; only successful completion adds exactly1 to L. New E permits additional studies; L<E only gates future additions, never truncates inherited L>E.
tradition_study.efficiency: Source ACTIVE IV: construction10+2*L%, existing legal Gold/Faith discount2*L%. Source ACTIVE III: base10%/0% only, L retained/no study. Below III: no source Standardization. Every template uses only its actual valid holder sources; an eligible III receiver may receive a stronger held template from another valid IV holder.
tradition_study.identity_exit: L retained, no study/no current local Industry output; qualified IV return directly restores all L without relearning.
tradition_study.owner_change: L follows same city without owner partition. Future enabled Owner at legal Industry IV may use full L even if national E<L. No downgrade/deletion/clamp; only future additions gated by E. Current unsupported Owner dormant.
tradition_study.persistence: Restore authoritative completed L history, then derive current eligibility/efficiencies from current facts; no old carrier/network snapshot replay. Exact storage/atomic submission/cold-load implementation is technical investigation.
tradition_study.interruption: Same full1T transaction semantics as Era Dialogue. Any study that does not fully complete the Production Turn fails and adds no L. Restart must redo the entire current1T round. Previously completed historical L is unaffected; do not replay an unfinished attempt as success.

pending_transaction.history_transition: Only a full uninterrupted Production Turn AND successful permanent commit adds exactly1 to completed city history L.
pending_transaction.cancellation: Cancel only the current unfinished round; no L increment or stored half-progress. Requalification at Industry ACTIVE IV and L<E permits a new full1T round; never pause/resume an incomplete turn.
pending_transaction.after_commit: Completed historical L follows the accepted A city lifecycle and is never erased by pending-round cancellation.

standardization_efficiency_by_template.holders: For each specific template T, collect only current valid Industry ACTIVE>=III sources that actually hold T under the retained local/network qualification.
standardization_efficiency_by_template.source_output: Each such source offers T at its own current qualified Standardization efficiency: III base10% construction/0% purchase; IV10%+2%*L construction and2%*L existing legal Gold/Faith purchase discount.
standardization_efficiency_by_template.merge: For T, construction MAX and highest legal purchase discount MAX independently within actual valid holders of T; no source stacking. Different templates UNION. A nonholder cannot amplify T regardless of its L or efficiency.
standardization_efficiency_by_template.example: A L7 holds University/Research Lab; B L2 holds University/Bank; C L5 holds Factory. Construction: University24%, Research Lab24%, Bank14%, Factory20%. C cannot amplify Bank.
standardization_efficiency_by_template.supersedes: Prior independent global efficiency maximum allowing template and strongest efficiency from unrelated sources (IND-REVIEW-03).

professional_unit_protection.rule: Construction Teams follow the shared professional-unit contract: cannot be captured by enemies or converted to another Owner; hostile interactions that would capture/destroy them use protective retreat/safe return.
professional_unit_protection.priority: Existing named special lifecycle/transaction rules remain prior. In Industry, source-city Owner transfer retains old Teams with original Owner, current-owner source capacity accounting and recapture rules unchanged; non-capture is not source transfer.
professional_unit_protection.technical_boundary: Exact native protection/retreat/safe-return interfaces and binding persistence require investigation; no Gameplay TBD for captured-unit ownership.

precision.integer_settlement: When Industry Production, Gold or Cost requires a final integer, use floor. Do not round-to-nearest, ceiling or compensate the difference.
precision.intermediate: Preserve the calculation until its required final integer settlement; avoid unnecessary repeated intermediate floors. The separately locked Team base capacity remains its existing integer unit value, not a transient city Production buff.
precision.technical_boundary: Native carrier, speed handling, modifier composition and exact final settlement path require technical validation; do not change Gameplay rounding to fit an interface.

review_markers.topic: City template ledger, learning/availability/propagation/use separation; retain prior mechanism for now, revisit later.
Prior activation directory and matching groups retained provisionally; districts included. Gold/Faith qualification is now formal D0045 and is not a conditional fallback.
Former independent global efficiency maximum is superseded: each template now takes separate construction/purchase MAX only among its actual current valid holders, per IND-STANDARD-SOURCE-001.

superseded_old_rules: Old Industry Lv3 +5Food and extra BASE-adjacency Gold removed; all levels3Food+K*A Production.
Old Industry IV50%actual Production network output removed; Network connectivity does not promise independent payload.
Ordinary District/Building Crew construction removed; only Wonders currently.
D0040 supersedes the current-completing-owner filter and conquered-Wonder exclusion for LOCAL Engineering Practice only; civilization Engineering Tradition attribution remains strict.
D0042 closes source-Owner-change Team survival/capacity; replaces blanket unresolved ownership wording only for source-city transfer, not direct unit capture or Owner disappearance.
D0044 replaces old Practice Standardization increments/caps with IV-only Team formation cost reduction; III always150%.
D0044 replaces Tradition/E Team IV/V unlock thresholds (including E4/5): level alone opens III I–III, IV IV–V.
D0044 replaces old Macro amplification of Team injection: fixed min(locked capacity,remaining Production), no ordinary production buff.
D0044 closes base Standardization numeric TBD with initial10% construction/0%Gold; IV city-study L adds2 percentage points each, not old level purchase ladder.
D0044 replaces Team cost reference280/460/820/1100/1500 with150/140/130/120% formation curve; base transfer250/420/750/1000/1360 retained.

D0045 supersedes IND-REVIEW-03 independent global best-efficiency sources: a specific template may use only efficiencies from actual current valid Industry holders of that template; different templates still UNION.
D0045 supersedes Faith-only-as-Gold-isolation-fallback: corresponding existing legal Gold/Faith channels both receive Standardization purchase discount, without new rights.
D0045 supersedes unfinished-study interruption TBD: incomplete full1T fails without L increment; restart repeats the current full1T round, completed city history L survives.
D0045 supersedes professional-unit captured-Owner Gameplay TBD with Shared non-capture/no-Owner-conversion and protective retreat/safe return; source-city transfer rules retained.
D0045 closes Gameplay rounding choice for final integer Production/Gold/Cost: floor, no round/ceiling/compensation, no unnecessary intermediate floors; actual native carrier still technical.

presentation_contract.existence: Cumulative permanent Potential>=level; ACTIVE decline does not remove institutions.
presentation_contract.representation: Presentation-only institution entries in Industrial Zone, not engine Buildings; excluded from ordinary building count, HD tiers, ordinary templates and other ordinary building enumerations unless expressly named.
